start.title: El encargo del amo
start.text:
Abraham es viejo. Te hace poner la mano debajo de su muslo.
«Jura por el Señor que no tomarás para Isaac una esposa de entre las cananeas».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Swear and accept the journey to his homeland
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You give your word. The journey begins in your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse — the road is too long for an old servant
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Abraham's eyes do not waver. The promise is heavier than the road.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Suggest a Canaanite girl from a wealthy house
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] "No," he says. "Not from this land. The Lord swore to my fathers."

refuse_consequence.title: Fe sobre el miedo
refuse_consequence.text:
Abraham solo sonríe. «El Señor, que me sacó de la casa de mi padre,
enviará a su ángel delante de ti».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Yield, and swear the oath
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You bow low. "I will go."

canaan_consequence.title: No de esta tierra
canaan_consequence.text:
«Mi hijo no debe volver allí. Pero tú quedarás libre del juramento
si la mujer no quiere seguirte».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Accept and swear properly
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You place your hand again, and swear by the Lord.

the_oath.title: Diez camellos cargados
the_oath.text:
Tomas diez camellos y lo mejor de los bienes de tu amo.
El camino a Mesopotamia es largo. Aram-Naharaim espera.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Set out at once with quiet trust
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You turn the caravan north. The desert opens before you.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Delay — gather more men and weapons first
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You linger over preparations. But faith does not wait on iron.

delay_consequence.title: El Señor es tu guarda
delay_consequence.text:
Las palabras de Abraham vuelven a ti: «Su ángel irá delante de ti».
Ninguna espada que lleves pesará más que esa promesa.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Set out in faith, with what you have
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You leave at first light. The camels' bells ring across the dunes.

the_well.title: El pozo de Najor
the_well.text:
Atardece. Llegas a un pozo de piedra a las afueras de la ciudad de Najor.
Es la hora en que las mujeres salen a sacar agua.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Make the camels kneel and pray for a sign
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You bow your head beside the kneeling beasts. "O Lord, God of my master Abraham…"

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk into the city and ask for Nahor's house
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Strangers are wary. No one knows you. You return to the well, weary.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Pick the most beautiful girl you see
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Beauty is not the sign. Your master sent you for kindness, not a face.

city_consequence.title: De vuelta al pozo
city_consequence.text:
La ciudad está cerrada para un extraño. El pozo es donde Dios responde.
Te arrodillas junto a los camellos.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Pray for a sign instead
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] "Lord, give me success today," you whisper.

beauty_consequence.title: No lo que ves
beauty_consequence.text:
Tu amo no te envió por los ojos de los hombres.
Te envió por el corazón que Dios elegirá.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bow your head and ask for the true sign
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You forget the faces and pray instead.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "She who offers to water my camels — let her be the one"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The words are barely out of your mouth when a girl appears with a jar on her shoulder.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "Send me a sign of fire from heaven"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The sky stays still. God answers in kindness, not in flame.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "The first one to greet me — let her be the one"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] A greeting costs nothing. Your master needs a heart that gives.

fire_consequence.title: Cielo en silencio
fire_consequence.text:
Los cielos no rugen. Esperan.
La señal de la elección de Dios será una pequeña bondad, no una maravilla.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Ask instead for the one who waters the camels
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You change your prayer — and a girl steps from the city gate.

greeting_consequence.title: Más que palabras
greeting_consequence.text:
Las palabras son fáciles. El servicio es el corazón que Dios lee.
Pide la señal que cuesta algo.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Pray for the one who will water the camels
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You change the prayer — and look up.

rebekah_arrives.title: Una joven en el pozo
rebekah_arrives.text:
Es joven, cautelosa, encantadora.
Llena su cántaro y se dispone a marcharse.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Run to her: "Please give me a little water from your jar"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice is humble. She stops and turns.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Order her to water your camels at once
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Her face hardens. She walks away without a word.

command_consequence.title: El orgullo la ahuyenta
command_consequence.text:
Se ha ido. Los camellos siguen sedientos.
Debes esperar —y preguntar a la siguiente con humildad.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Wait, and ask the next girl gently
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] She returns again, having forgotten her sandal. You speak softly this time.

rebekah_pov_request.title: La voz de un extraño
rebekah_pov_request.text:
Eres Rebeca, hija de Betuel.
Un anciano polvoriento en el pozo pide un sorbo de agua.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "Drink, my lord" — and offer to draw for his camels too
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You lower the jar to his hands. "I will draw for your camels also, until they have done."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Give him only a sip and hurry home
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your jar is heavy. But the camels watch you with tired, dust-rimmed eyes.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse — your father warned you about strangers
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He has not asked for much. A sip of water is no danger.

stingy_consequence.title: Los ojos de los camellos
stingy_consequence.text:
Diez camellos. Días en el desierto. Su sed es enorme.
Tu madre te enseñó a ser mejor que esto.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Turn back and offer to water them all
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You return to the trough. "I will draw for your camels also."

refuse_water_consequence.title: [TODO:es] A Sip Is No Sin
refuse_water_consequence.text:
Es viejo, encorvado y polvoriento. El pozo es el lugar de reunión.
La hospitalidad es la ley de tu pueblo.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Offer him drink — and the camels too
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You lift the jar. "Drink, my lord."

watering_camels.title: Hasta que hayan terminado
watering_camels.text:
Corres entre el pozo y el abrevadero hasta que te duelen los brazos.
Diez camellos beben hasta saciarse. El anciano te observa en silencio.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Finish the work fully, then ask if he needs more
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You set the empty jar down. He has not moved his eyes from you.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stop halfway — surely that is enough
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The camels still murmur with thirst. The work is not done.

halfway_consequence.title: Hasta que beba el último
halfway_consequence.text:
El Señor observa el trabajo que está terminado, no el que está empezado.
Los camellos siguen apiñándose cerca del abrevadero.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Return to the well and finish
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You draw and pour until every beast turns away satisfied.

the_gifts.title: Oro en su mano
the_gifts.text:
El viejo sirviente toma un pesado anillo de oro y dos brazaletes.
«Dime, ¿de quién eres hija? ¿Hay sitio en la casa de tu padre?»

choices.text: [TODO:es] "I am Bethuel's daughter — son of Milcah and Nahor"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His face changes. He bows his head to the ground at once.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Hide your name — he might be a thief
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His kind eyes do not look like a thief's. The truth would have cost you nothing.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take the gold and run home without answering
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You clutch the gold to your chest. But the man's voice follows you, gentle, unhurried.

hide_consequence.title: La mano del Señor es evidente
hide_consequence.text:
Las lágrimas del hombre dicen lo que ningún ladrón podría fingir.
«Bendito sea el Señor, el Dios de mi señor Abraham», murmura.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Tell him your true name
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] "I am Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel, son of Milcah."

run_consequence.title: No te ha hecho daño
run_consequence.text:
Es viejo, está solo y llora de alegría junto al pozo.
No es un ladrón. El Señor está en este encuentro.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Return and tell him your name
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You walk back. "I am Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel."

the_blessing_well.title: Bendito sea el Señor
the_blessing_well.text:
Inclina la cabeza hasta el suelo, llorando.
«Bendito sea el Señor, que me ha guiado a la casa de los hermanos de mi señor».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Run home and tell your mother's house everything
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You run, the gold catching the last sun. The house must hear of this.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Say nothing — keep the gold for yourself
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The Lord's hand cannot be hidden in a pocket. Your mother sees the gold at once.

secret_consequence.title: El oro habla por ti
secret_consequence.text:
Los brazaletes brillan en tu muñeca. Tu madre jadea.
Pide que le cuenten toda la historia.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Tell her everything truthfully
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your brother Laban listens with widening eyes — and runs out toward the well.

laban_meets.title: Labán lo trae
laban_meets.text:
Tu hermano Labán corre al pozo y trae al hombre a casa.
Los camellos son descargados. Se trae agua para sus pies.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Set bread and wine before him at once
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Food is laid on the low table. He raises his hand: "I will not eat until I have told my errand."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Demand to know his business first
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His face stiffens. A guest is honored before he is questioned.

demand_consequence.title: Primero la bienvenida
demand_consequence.text:
Tu padre Betuel sacude la cabeza suavemente.
«Primero el pan. Luego sus palabras».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Set the table and listen properly
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You bring the bread. The lamp is lit. He begins to speak.

the_errand_told.title: Soy el siervo de Abraham
the_errand_told.text:
Él cuenta todo: el juramento, el viaje, la oración en el pozo,
tu amabilidad, la señal del Señor. La habitación queda en silencio.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bethuel and Laban speak: "This thing is from the Lord"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] "We cannot speak to you bad or good. Take her, and let her be your master's son's wife."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse — the journey is too far, and he is a stranger
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The servant lifts his hands. "Hinder me not — the Lord has prospered my way."

stranger_consequence.title: El Señor ha prosperado su camino
stranger_consequence.text:
Cada palabra que ha pronunciado lleva la marca de la mano de Dios.
¿Quién puede oponerse a lo que el Señor ha elegido?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bow to the will of the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your father lifts his eyes. "Let it be as the Lord has said."

rebekahs_choice.title: ¿Irás con este hombre?
rebekahs_choice.text:
Por la mañana el siervo dice: «Envíame de vuelta a mi señor».
Tu familia pregunta: «Que se quede con nosotros unos días, al menos diez».
Luego se vuelven hacia ti. «¿Irás con este hombre?»

choices.text: [TODO:es] "I will go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Two words. Quiet, certain. The whole house falls still.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "Let me wait ten days at least"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The servant's face is pleading. The Lord's hand has been on this from the first hour.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "I will not leave my mother's house"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your mother lowers her eyes. The God who called Abraham is calling you now.

wait_consequence.title: El Señor ya ha hablado
wait_consequence.text:
La señal fue dada. El oro fue dado. El camino está abierto.
¿Qué son diez días frente al llamado de Dios?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Change your answer — "I will go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You straighten. "I will go." Your nurse begins quietly to pack.

stay_consequence.title: Una casa más grande espera
stay_consequence.text:
Tu madre te toma la mano. «Hija, el Señor ha elegido.
Ve a donde Él te envíe. Nuestra bendición te acompaña».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Answer at last: "I will go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You let her hand go. "I will go."

the_blessing_send.title: Madre de millares
the_blessing_send.text:
Tu familia te bendice en la puerta:
«Sé madre de millares de millones.
Que tu descendencia posea las puertas de los que los odian».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Mount the camel and ride out with the servant
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your nurse Deborah climbs up beside you. The caravan turns south toward Canaan.

the_road_home.title: Hacia el sur, hacia Canaán
the_road_home.text:
El desierto se extiende por muchos días. El siervo cabalga adelante, vigilante y silencioso.
Sientes la mano del Señor en cada milla.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Trust the journey and pray as you ride
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The wind moves the veil at your face. The sky deepens to evening.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Beg the servant to turn the caravan back
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He shakes his head, kindly. "The Lord goes before us, my lady."

turn_back_consequence.title: Adelante es el camino
turn_back_consequence.text:
El Señor no te ha guiado hasta aquí para hacerte volver.
La tierra prometida está adelante, justo sobre las colinas.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Settle into the saddle and ride on
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You pull the veil closer. The caravan keeps moving.

isaac_in_field.title: Un hombre en el campo
isaac_in_field.text:
Al atardecer ves las colinas del Néguev.
Un hombre camina solo por el campo, en el tiempo de la meditación.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Ask the servant: "Who is this man?"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] "It is my master," he says. You take your veil and cover your face.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Ride past — he is none of your business
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The servant gently raises his hand: "My lady — that is the man."

ride_past_consequence.title: Ese es el hombre
ride_past_consequence.text:
Tu corazón se acelera en tu pecho.
Te bajas del camello y te cubres el rostro con el velo.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk forward to meet him
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Across the field, Isaac stops. He has been waiting longer than you know.

the_meeting.title: Isaac y Rebeca
the_meeting.text:
El siervo le cuenta a Isaac todo lo que ha sucedido.
Isaac te lleva a la tienda de su madre Sara.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand with him beneath the open sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He takes your hand. The wind is soft over the field of evening.

the_comfort.title: Y la amó
the_comfort.text:
Isaac tomó a Rebeca, y ella se convirtió en su esposa.
Y la amó, y fue consolado después de la muerte de su madre.
La promesa a Abraham continúa, hacia otra generación.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Step into the story God has written
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The lamp glows in Sarah's tent. The covenant continues.
